usageNotes: Use this to wipe and initialize a raw block device on a PVE node with a fresh GPT partition table before creating partitions or adding the disk to a storage pool. The disk must not be mounted or in use (e.g. not part of an active ZFS pool or LVM group). Returns a UPID string; poll the tasks API to confirm completion before issuing follow-up disk operations.

examples.summary: Initialize /dev/sdb with a new GPT table on node pve1

tips: Check current disk usage first via get_nodes_node_disks_list to confirm the target disk is not mounted or part of an existing storage.
Omit the uuid parameter to let Proxmox generate a random GPT UUID automatically — only supply it when you need a deterministic UUID (e.g. scripted reprovisioning).
After the task UPID completes, the disk will have a GPT label but no partitions — use subsequent partition/storage APIs to finish setup.
Requires Sys.Modify at the root path; API tokens must have this privilege explicitly granted.
